questions.subject: Evidence
questions.question:
In a jury trial, the plaintiff sued the defendant for breach of contract. The plaintiff's position was that a woman whom he understood to be the defendant's agent said: "On behalf of [the defendant], I accept your offer." The defendant asserted that the woman had no actual or apparent authority to accept the offer on the defendant's behalf.
Is the plaintiff's testimony concerning the woman's statement admissible?

choices.A: No, because it is hearsay not within any exception.
choices.B: No, if the woman does not testify and her absence is not excused.
choices.C: Yes, provided the court first finds by a preponderance of the evidence that the woman had actual or apparent authority to act for the defendant.
choices.D: Yes, upon or subject to introduction of evidence sufficient to support a finding by the jury that the woman had actual or apparent authority to act for the defendant.

questions.explanation:
Nonhearsay statements
(FRE 801(d))
Statement by declarant-witness
Out-of-court statement admissible if witness subject to cross-examination & prior statement:
  • is inconsistent with current testimony & was made under penalty of perjury
  • is consistent with current testimony & offered to (1) rebut charge of fabrication/improper influence or (2) rehabilitate witness or
  • identifies person witness perceived earlier
Statement by party-opponent
Out-of-court statement admissible if offered against opposing party & statement was:
  • made or adopted by party
  • made by person authorized by party
  • made by party's agent/employee on matter within scope of relationship or
  • made by party's coconspirator during & in furtherance of conspiracy
FRE = Federal Rule of Evidence.

Hearsay is an out-of-court statement offered to prove the truth of the matter asserted therein and is generally inadmissible. But certain statements, though they meet this definition, are considered nonhearsay and can therefore be used as substantive evidence. This includes statements made by or attributable to an opposing party when offered against that party. One way a statement is attributable to an opposing party is if:

  • the declarant was the opposing party's agent—ie, had actual or apparent authority to act on the party's behalf and
  • the statement (1) was made during the agency relationship and (2) concerned a matter within the scope of that relationship.

The relevance of such statements is conditioned upon the declarant's authority to act on the opposing party's behalf. As a result, the court must determine if there is sufficient evidence for a reasonable jury to find that this preliminary fact exists.

Here, the plaintiff seeks to introduce the woman's statement accepting the plaintiff's offer on the defendant's behalf. If the plaintiff introduces evidence that would allow a reasonable jury to find that the woman had actual or apparent authority (ie, agency) to act for the defendant, then her statement is admissible nonhearsay (Choice A).

(Choice B) A statement attributable to an opposing party is admissible against that party regardless of the declarant's availability. Therefore, the woman's absence—whether excused or not—and failure to testify do not bar admission of her statement.

(Choice C) Courts typically apply the preponderance-of-the-evidence standard to decide preliminary questions of admissibility—eg, whether a witness is qualified to testify, privilege exists, etc. However, when the relevance of evidence is conditioned upon the existence of a preliminary fact (as seen here), the court need only find that there is sufficient evidence to support (but not necessarily establish) the existence of that preliminary fact.

📌 Educational Objective

A statement is attributable to an opposing party and therefore admissible nonhearsay if it is offered against that party and was (1) made by the party's agent (2) about a matter within the scope of an existing agency relationship.

📚 References
  • Fed. R. Evid. 801(d)(2) (nonhearsay – statement by party-opponent)

zh-choices.B: 否，如果该女性不出庭作证且其缺席没有正当理由。

questions.zh-explanation:
MBE 考点解析

Evidence: Hearsay - What Is Not Hearsay

本题真正考的是

一句话定位考点

本题真正考的是：对方当事人的代理人陈述（statement by party-opponent’s agent）能不能作为非传闻（nonhearsay）进来，不是看这个人来不来作证。

三秒认题路径：

代理人说话 → 对方使用 → 看授权 → 看范围 → 进证据

核心法律规则

传闻（hearsay）是庭外陈述拿来证明陈述内容真伪，默认不能进。对方当事人陈述（party-opponent statement）之所以能进，是因为它被当成对方自己的话，考场意思：拿来打对方，不用再等“例外”。

如果说话人是对方的代理人（agent），而且在代理关系存续期间、就该关系范围内的事说话，这句话就可能算进来。这里不用法官先“证明到底真不真”，只要有足够证据让陪审团合理认定有授权即可。

核心判例： 这题直接对应 FRE 801(d)(2)(D) 的代理人陈述规则：先有足够证据支持“她是代理人且在范围内说话”，就能作为非传闻使用。

思维导图

对方想把这句话当证据用吗？
先看：是不是对方当事人陈述（party-opponent statement）？
是：若说话人是被告的代理人（agent），且在代理关系内谈的是范围内事项，就能往下走。
关键卡点：法庭要的不是“先把授权完全证明死”，而是“有足够证据让陪审团合理认定”。
卡死点：不用先按preponderance of the evidence证明成立。
结论：只要能支持“有实际或表见授权”，这句“On behalf of [the defendant], I accept your offer.” 就能进。
所以答案：D

考点陷阱

你可能会想：这人没出庭、也没被证明真有授权，所以应该先挡掉。

但考试真正问的是：这句话是不是对方当事人可归责陈述，以及是否有足够证据支持“代理关系存在”。

司法考试看的是「法律程序上能不能救济」，而不是「事实背景里听起来像不像真的」。

正确答案与干扰项排除

为什么选 D？

题干的 On behalf of [the defendant] 是典型对方代理人陈述；只要有证据足以支持她有实际或表见授权，这句话就能作为非传闻进入。

❌ 概念混淆 | 传闻误认

✕ A: 把对方当事人陈述误当成普通hearsay，忽略 801(d) 直接放行。

❌ 事实误判 | 出庭条件偷换

✕ B: 把“她不来作证”当成阻却理由，但这类陈述不靠宣誓出庭也能进。

❌ 法律适用 | 证明标准套错

✕ C: 把 preponderance 搬来这里，错把“可支持认定”说成“必须先证明成立”。

这题建议用什么方法？

先抓“谁在替谁说话”，再看授权范围；能让陪审团合理认定就够了。

考场速记

记住一句：对方代理人在授权范围内说的话，先按 801(d)(2) 想，不要先纠结他来不来作证。

questions.subject: Evidence
questions.question:
At a defendant's trial for the sale of drugs, the government called a drug user to testify, but the drug user refused to answer any questions about the defendant and was held in contempt of court. The government then calls an officer to testify that, when the drug user was arrested for possession of drugs and offered leniency if he would identify his source, the drug user had named the defendant as his source.
Is the officer's testimony concerning the drug user's identification of the defendant admissible?

choices.A: No, because it is hearsay not within any exception.
choices.B: No, because the drug user was not confronted with the statement while on the stand.
choices.C: Yes, as a prior inconsistent statement by the drug user.
choices.D: Yes, as an identification of the defendant by the drug user after having perceived the defendant.

questions.explanation:
Nonhearsay statements
(FRE 801(d))
Statement by
declarant-witness 		Out-of-court statement admissible if witness subject to cross-examination & prior statement:
  • is inconsistent with current testimony & was made under penalty of perjury
  • is consistent with current testimony & offered to (1) rebut charge of fabrication/improper influence or (2) rehabilitate witness or
  • identifies person witness perceived earlier
Statement by
party-opponent 		Out-of-court statement admissible if offered against opposing party & statement was:
  • made or adopted by party
  • made by person authorized by party
  • made by party's agent/employee on matter within scope of relationship or
  • made by party's coconspirator during & in furtherance of conspiracy
FRE = Federal Rule of Evidence.

Hearsay is an out-of-court statement offered to prove the truth of the matter asserted therein and is generally inadmissible. But certain statements—though they meet this definition—are excluded from this rule and considered nonhearsay. For example, a declarant-witness's prior statement is nonhearsay if (1) the witness testifies and is subject to cross-examination about the statement and (2) the statement:

  • is inconsistent with the witness's current testimony and was made under penalty of perjury
  • is consistent with the witness's current testimony and offered to (1) rebut a charge of fabrication or improper influence or (2) rehabilitate the witness's credibility or
  • identifies a person as someone the witness perceived earlier.

Here, the drug user's out-of-court statement is being offered for the truth of the matter asserted—i.e., that the defendant was the drug user's source. And though the statement identifies a person the drug user perceived earlier, it is not excluded from the hearsay rule because the drug user did not testify (Choice D). And since no other exclusion or exceptionException (例外): A provision that allows hearsay statements to be admitted if they meet certain criteria of reliability. to the hearsay rule applies, the statement is inadmissible.

(Choice B) A declarant need not be confronted with an out-of-court statement on the stand before it can be admitted. Therefore, a failure to do so is not a basis to exclude the officer's testimony.

(Choice C) A prior statement that (1) is inconsistent with a witness's testimony and (2) was made under oath is nonhearsay if the declarant testifies and is subject to cross-examination about the statement. But this rule is inapplicable here since the drug user did not testify at trial.

📌 Educational Objective

A witness's prior statement that identifies a person as someone the witness perceived earlier is nonhearsay if the witness testifies and is subject to cross-examination about the statement.

📚 References
  • Fed. R. Evid. 801(d)(1) (nonhearsay statements – witness's prior statement).
questions.zh-question:
在一场关于被告人贩卖毒品的审判中，政府传唤一名吸毒者作证，但这名吸毒者拒绝回答任何关于被告人的问题，并因此被裁定藐视法庭。随后，政府传唤一名警官作证，该警官称，当这名吸毒者因持有毒品被捕，并被告知如果指认其毒品来源即可获得宽大处理时，该吸毒者指认被告人为其来源。

警官关于吸毒者指认被告人的证词是否可以采纳？

zh-choices.A: 不可以，因为该证词属于传闻证据，且不符合任何例外情况。
zh-choices.B: 不可以，因为该吸毒者在证人席上时，并未被要求就该陈述进行对质。
zh-choices.C: 可以，因为这属于该吸毒者先前作出的不一致陈述。
zh-choices.D: 可以，因为这属于该吸毒者在感知被告人后作出的指认。

questions.zh-explanation:
MBE 考点解析

Evidence: Hearsay - Definition of hearsay

本题真正考的是

一句话定位考点

本题真正考的是：传闻证据（hearsay）里，只有当宣誓陈述人亲自出庭并可交叉询问时，先前辨认（prior identification）才可能被当成非传闻；这题里那个人根本没作证，所以不能直接进。

三秒认题路径：

庭外说法 → 要证明真伪 → 人没作证 → 无非传闻例外 → 选 A

核心法律规则

传闻（hearsay）就是庭外陈述拿来证明陈述内容是真的；原则上不能进。先前陈述（prior statement）只有在陈述人本人出庭，并且就这句话接受交叉询问时，才可能被排除在传闻规则外。先前辨认（prior identification）是其中一种，但前提还是“人得上庭”。

核心判例： FRE 801(d)(1)(C) - 先前辨认只有在辨认人出庭且可交叉询问时，才是非传闻；这题缺了这个前提，所以仍是传闻。

思维导图

先看：这句话是不是拿来证明“被告就是货源”这个事实？
是 → 这是传闻（hearsay）。
再问：能不能走 FRE 801(d)(1)(C) 的先前辨认？
关键门槛：辨认人必须出庭，并且可被交叉询问。
卡死点：毒品使用者拒答，等于没有完成“出庭作证 + 可交叉询问”，所以非传闻通道直接关闭。
结果：不能靠“先前辨认”洗白，答案还是 A。

考点陷阱

你可能会想：他当场认出了“来源”，而且还在被捕后说的，听起来很可靠。
但考试真正问的是：这个庭外说法能不能因为 prior identification 直接变成非传闻，而不是它看起来像不像真话。

司法考试看的是「法律程序上能不能救济」，而不是「物理上的秘密有没有泄露」。

正确答案与干扰项排除

为什么选 A？

题干的 drug user did not testify 是决定点；没有出庭可交叉询问，就不能把这句先前辨认当成 FRE 801(d)(1)(C) 的非传闻。

❌ 概念混淆 | 规则渊源误判

✕ B: 把 confronted 当成必备条件了；传闻规则不要求先当面对质。

❌ 法律适用 | 前提缺失误判

✕ C: 盯住 prior inconsistent，却忘了陈述人根本没上庭。

❌ 事实误判 | 目击前提偷换

✕ D: 把“认出人”误当成“现场看见”，这题只是辨认被告，不是当场目击。

这题建议用什么方法？

先找传闻目的，再查非传闻例外的前提，特别是“人有没有出庭”。

考场速记

记住一句：先前辨认（prior identification）不是自动放行，先问“辨认人有没有作证、能不能被交叉询问”。
这题的秒杀点就是：no testimony, no 801(d)(1)(C)。

D.text: identification of the defendant by the drug user after having perceived the defendant

questions.subject: Evidence
questions.question:
A homeowner sued a plumber for damages resulting from the plumber's allegedly faulty installation of water pipes in her basement, which caused flooding. At trial, the homeowner is prepared to testify that when she first detected the flooding, she turned off the water and called the plumber at his emergency number for help and that the plumber responded, "I'll come by tomorrow and redo the installation for free."
Is the homeowner's testimony regarding the plumber's response admissible?

choices.A: No, because it is hearsay not within any exception.
choices.B: No, because the statement was an offer in compromise.
choices.C: Yes, as a subsequent remedial measure.
choices.D: Yes, as evidence of the plumber's fault.

questions.explanation:
Nonhearsay statements (FRE 801(d))
Statement by
declarant-witness 		Out-of-court statement admissible if witness subject to cross-examination & prior statement:
  • is inconsistent with current testimony & was made under penalty of perjury
  • is consistent with current testimony & offered to (1) rebut charge of fabrication/improper influence or (2) rehabilitate witness or
  • identifies person witness perceived earlier
Statement by
party-opponent 		Out-of-court statement admissible if offered against opposing party & statement was:
  • made or adopted by party
  • made by person authorized by party
  • made by party's agent/employee on matter within scope of relationship or
  • made by party's coconspirator during & in furtherance of conspiracy
FRE = Federal Rule of Evidence.

Hearsay is an out-of-court statement offered to prove the truth of the matter asserted therein and is generally inadmissible. But Federal Rule of Evidence (FRE) 801 excludes some statements from the rule against hearsay and allows them to be offered as substantive evidence (eg, to establish fault). This includes statements made by an opposing party that are offered against that party.

Here, the homeowner seeks to introduce the plumber's out-of-court statement—that he would redo the installation for free—to prove that his initial pipe installation was faulty. But since this statement was made by the plumber (a party-opponent) and is being offered against him at trial, it is excluded from the rule against hearsay. Therefore, the statement can be used as evidence of the plumber's fault (Choice D).

(Choice B) Under FRE 408, an offer of compromise (ie, settlement offer) is inadmissible to prove the validity or amount of a disputed claim. But this rule only applies if there was a pending dispute at the time the offer was made (not seen here).

(Choice C) FRE 407 bars the admission of subsequent remedial measures to prove a party's negligence or culpable conduct. But here, the homeowner is seeking to introduce the plumber's statement—not any subsequent measures taken to remedy the flooding.

📌 Educational Objective

Statements of an opposing party are excluded from the rule against hearsay—and are admissible as substantive evidence—when offered against that party.

📚 References
  • Fed. R. Evid. 801 (nonhearsay statements).
questions.zh-question:
一名房主因水管工据称在其地下室安装水管存在缺陷并导致洪水而起诉该水管工，要求赔偿损失。在庭审中，房主准备作证说，当她初次发现洪水时，她关掉了水阀，并拨打水管工的紧急电话求助，水管工回应说：“我明天会过来免费重新安装。”

房主关于水管工回应的证言是否可采纳？

zh-choices.A: 否，因为它是传闻证据，且不符合任何例外情况。
zh-choices.B: 否，因为该陈述是和解要约。
zh-choices.C: 是，作为事后补救措施。
zh-choices.D: 是，作为水管工存在过错的证据。

questions.zh-explanation:
MBE 考点解析

Evidence: Hearsay - What Is Not Hearsay

本题真正考的是

一句话定位考点

本题真正考的是：对方当事人自己说的话，被拿来对付他时，通常不是 hearsay，能直接当实体证据用。

三秒认题路径：

对方自己说 → 拿来告他 → 801(d) → 非 hearsay → 选 D

核心法律规则

传闻证据（hearsay）是庭外陈述拿来证明陈述内容为真，通常不能进。对方当事人陈述（statement by party-opponent）是例外，不是为了“听起来像证据”，而是因为这句话本来就是拿来对付说话那一方的，所以能直接当 substantive evidence 用。

这题里，房主想用 plumber 亲口说的“我明天免费重做”去证明他原来的安装有问题；这句话是 对方当事人陈述（party-opponent statement），而且正好是拿来对付 plumber，所以不受 hearsay 规则排除。

核心判例： 本题不靠特定判例，直接卡在 FRE 801(d)(2)：对方当事人陈述被拿来对付该当事人时，通常可采。

思维导图

先问：这句话是不是庭外说的？
是 接着问：是不是拿来证明“这句话说的内容是真的”？
是 那它就是 hearsay 候选；继续找 801(d) 例外/排除。
本题命门
plumber 自己说“我明天免费重做” → 被房主拿来对付他 → 对方当事人陈述（party-opponent statement） → 直接出局于 hearsay 之外
别被带跑 它不是在问 settlement offer，也不是在问后续补救措施；题目只是在问这句话能不能作为 fault 的证据。
结论 可采，选 D

考点陷阱

你可能会想：他说“免费重做”，听起来像是认错，所以是不是 offer in compromise，或者是 subsequent remedial measure。

但考试真正问的是：这句话是谁说的、是拿来对付谁的。司法考试看的是「法律程序上能不能救济」，而不是「物理上的秘密有没有泄露」。这里没有后续实际修复动作，只有 plumber 自己的庭外陈述；先按 对方当事人陈述（party-opponent statement） 处理，别被“像和解”“像补救”骗走。

正确答案与干扰项排除

为什么选 D？

题干 plumber 自己说的庭外陈述 正被拿来对付他，属于 对方当事人陈述（party-opponent statement），所以可作为故障安装的实体证据。

❌ 概念混淆 | 传闻总排除

✕ A: 你把所有庭外话都当 hearsay，漏掉了对方当事人陈述这个排除项。

❌ 法律适用 | 和解场景误套

✕ B: 你把“免费重做”硬拽成 offer in compromise，但题干没有正在谈判的争议场景。

❌ 事实误判 | 补救动作偷换

✕ C: 你把一句话当成 subsequent remedial，但题目里根本没有实际修复行为。

这题建议用什么方法？

先看陈述人是不是对方当事人，再看这句话是不是被拿来对付他说话的人。

考场速记

记住一句：对方当事人陈述（party-opponent statement），一旦是拿来告对方，就先别急着喊 hearsay。碰到“自己说的话被拿来打自己”，优先想 FRE 801(d)(2)。

questions.subject: Evidence
questions.question:
A defendant has been charged with murder. The defendant has pleaded not guilty, claiming that on the night of the murder, he was visiting a friend in a neighboring town. During the investigation, a detective interviewed the friend. The friend informed the detective that he and his wife hosted a dinner party at their home on the night of the murder. The friend stated that the dinner party was attended by the defendant and the friend's sister. The friend further stated that the defendant became intoxicated at the dinner party, so the friend took the keys to the defendant's vehicle to prevent the defendant from leaving. Soon after the interview with the detective, the friend died.
Prior to trial, the defendant properly notified the prosecution of his intent to introduce the transcript of the friend's unsworn interview with the detective at trial.
Is the transcript of the friend's unsworn interview with the detective admissible?

choices.A: No, because it is hearsay not within any exception.
choices.B: No, because its admission violates the Sixth Amendment confrontation clause.
choices.C: Yes, because the friend is unavailable to testify.
choices.D: Yes, under the residual hearsay exception.

questions.explanation:
Residual hearsay exception
Does statement fall under specific hearsay exception or exclusion?
Yes
➔ Admit
No ▼
Is it supported by sufficient guarantees of trustworthiness after considering:
  • totality of circumstances surrounding its making and
  • any corroborating evidence?
No
➔ Exclude
Yes ▼
Is statement more probative than other reasonably obtainable evidence?
No
➔ Exclude
Yes ▼
Admit
(if opponent was given reasonable notice of intent to offer statement)

The rule against hearsay bars the admission of out-of-court statements offered to prove the truth of the matter asserted therein. However, certain statements are expressly excluded or exceptedExclusions & Exceptions
Specific categories under the Federal Rules of Evidence where hearsay statements are admissible (e.g., excited utterances, party-opponent admissions).排除或例外 from the rule. And even when no specific exception applies, a hearsay statement is admissible under the residual or catchall exception if:

  • the statement is supported by sufficient guarantees of trustworthiness
  • the statement is more probative on the point than any other evidence obtainable through reasonable efforts and
  • the proponent gives the adverse party notice of the intent to offer the statement.

Here, the defendant sought to introduce the deceased friend's hearsay statement. The statement does not fall under any specific hearsay exclusion or exception. And though the defendant notified the prosecution of his intent to introduce the statement, it is not admissible under the residual hearsay exception. That is because testimony regarding the defendant's whereabouts on the night of the murder is reasonably obtainable from other sources—eg, the friend's wife or sister (Choice D). Therefore, the transcript of the friend's unsworn interview is not admissible.

(Choice B) The confrontation clause bars admission of a testimonial statement against a defendant unless (1) the declarant is unavailableUnavailability (FRE 804)
Includes situations where the declarant is deceased, has a privilege, refuses to testify, lacks memory, or is outside the subpoena power.证人无法出庭 and (2) the defendant had a prior opportunity to cross-examine the declarant. Here, the friend's statement was offered by (not against) the defendant, so the confrontation clause is not implicated.

(Choice C) The friend is unavailable since he is deceased. However, his statement must still meet the requirements of a hearsay exclusion or exception to be admissible (not seen here).

📌 Educational Objective

A hearsay statement is admissible under the residual or catchall exception if (1) the statement is supported by sufficient guarantees of trustworthiness, (2) it is more probative on the point than any other evidence obtainable through reasonable efforts, and (3) the proponent gives the adverse party notice of the intent to offer the statement.

📚 References
  • Fed. R. Evid. 807 (residual hearsay exception).
questions.zh-question:
被告被控谋杀罪。被告拒不认罪，声称在谋杀案发生当晚，他正在邻镇拜访一位朋友。在调查期间，一名侦探讯问了这位朋友。这位朋友告诉侦探，在谋杀案发生当晚，他和妻子在家中举办了一场晚宴。朋友表示，被告和朋友的妹妹参加了这场晚宴。朋友还表示，被告在晚宴上喝醉了，所以朋友拿走了被告车辆的钥匙，以阻止被告离开。在接受侦探讯问后不久，这位朋友去世了。
庭审前，被告正式通知控方，他打算在庭审中提交该朋友与侦探之间未宣誓讯问的笔录。
该朋友与侦探之间未宣誓讯问的笔录是否可采纳？

zh-choices.A: 否，因为它属于 hearsay（传闻证据），且不属于任何例外情况。
zh-choices.B: 否，因为采纳该证据违反了第六修正案的 confrontation clause（对质条款）。
zh-choices.C: 是，因为该朋友无法出庭作证。
zh-choices.D: 是，根据 residual hearsay exception（剩余传闻例外）。

questions.zh-explanation:
MBE 考点解析

Evidence: Hearsay - Miscellaneous

本题真正考的是

一句话定位考点

本题真正考的是：传闻例外（hearsay exception）里，残余例外（residual hearsay exception）能不能把一份未宣誓的庭外陈述救回来。

三秒认题路径：

庭外陈述 → 想证真伪 → 无特例 → 看残余例外 → 仍排除

核心法律规则

传闻（hearsay）是为了证明陈述内容为真而拿出的庭外陈述，默认不能进。残余例外（residual hearsay exception）只在没有具体例外时才考虑，而且还要同时满足：有足够的可信保障、比其他可合理取得的证据更有证明力、并且已经提前通知对方。

这里虽然朋友已经死亡，属于 unavailable，但这只解决“人能不能出庭”，不等于“这句话就能进”。本题里现场情况、朋友妻子、朋友姐姐都能讲到被告当晚去了哪里，所以这份未宣誓访谈不是最有证明力的那份证据，残余例外过不了。

核心判例：FRE 807 的逻辑就是：不是“听起来真”就够了，还是要先找不到更好的替代证据，才能放行。

思维导图

先问：这份朋友访谈是不是要拿来证明“被告当晚确实在朋友家”这个事实？
是 这就是传闻（hearsay），先默认排除。
下一关 有无具体例外？这里没有。
再看 能不能走残余例外（residual exception）：
1. 可信度够不够？题干没给强力佐证。
2. 是否更有证明力 more probative？否，因为朋友的妻子和姐姐也能证明同一件事。
3. 是否提前通知？题干说有通知，但前两关已经卡死。
结论：第三关不过，不能靠残余例外放行 → 选 A。

考点陷阱

你可能会想：朋友已经死了，unavailable，那他的话是不是更容易进？

但考试真正问的是：有没有一个具体的传闻例外能接住它。司法考试看的是「法律程序上能不能救济」，而不是「物理上的秘密有没有泄露」。 这里其他证人也能讲同一事实，所以不能拿残余例外来兜底。

正确答案与干扰项排除

为什么选 A？

题干的未宣誓警探访谈是庭外陈述，且没有落入任何具体例外；又因为还有其他更可取得的证据，所以残余例外也救不回来。

❌ 概念混淆 | 特权救济误判

✕ B: 把 Sixth Amendment 乱套到“被告自己拿来用”的证据上了。

❌ 事实误判 | 死亡即放行

✕ C: 只看到证人死了，就误以为自动可采。

❌ 法律适用 | 兜底条件误套

✕ D: 先拿 residual exception 当万能兜底，但忽略了更好的证据就在旁边。

这题建议用什么方法？

先锁定“庭外陈述+证真伪”，再按“具体例外→残余例外→是否有更好证据”三步排除。

考场速记

记住一句：残余例外（residual hearsay exception）不是“差不多可信就行”，而是“没有更好的证据时才轮到它”。

口诀：先找具体例外，再看可信度，最后看有没有更好替代；有更好证据，就别想走兜底。

questions.subject: Evidence
questions.question:
A defendant was prosecuted for bankruptcy fraud. The defendant's wife, now deceased, had testified adversely to the defendant during earlier bankruptcy proceedings that involved similar issues. Although the wife had been cross-examined, no serious effort was made to challenge her credibility despite the availability of significant impeachment information. At the fraud trial, the prosecutor offers into evidence the testimony given by the defendant's wife at the bankruptcy proceeding.
Is this evidence admissible?

choices.A: No, because it is hearsay not within any exception.
choices.B: No, because the defendant has the right to prevent use of his spouse's testimony against him in a criminal case.
choices.C: Yes, because it is a statement by a person identified with a party.
choices.D: Yes, under the hearsay exception for former testimony.

questions.explanation:
Former testimony
(FRE 804(b)(1))
Hearsay exception for unavailable declarant's testimony that:
  • was given at trial, hearing, or deposition in current case or different proceeding that involved similar parties & issues and
  • is offered against party who had opportunity & similar motive to develop testimony by direct or cross-examination
FRE = Federal Rule of Evidence.

The rule against hearsay prohibits the admission of a statement made outside the present proceeding that is offered for the truth of the matter asserted therein. However, one exception to this rule permits admission of an unavailableDeclarant is unavailable due to death, privilege, illness, lack of memory, or refusal to testify. (无法出庭的声明人) (e.g., deceased) declarant's former testimony if:

  • the testimony was given at a trial, hearing, or deposition in the current case or a different proceeding that involved similar parties and issues and
  • the party against whom the testimony is offered had an opportunity and similar motive to develop that testimony through direct or cross-examination of the declarant.

Here, the prosecution sought to introduce the deceased wife's prior testimony against the defendant at his fraud trial. Her testimony was given at earlier bankruptcy proceedings that involved similar issues. And though the defendant made no significant effort to discredit the wife at those proceedings, he had an opportunity and similar motive to do so on cross-examination.* Therefore, the wife's testimony is admissible under the hearsay exception for former testimony (Choice A).

*The admission of the wife's former testimony does not raise Sixth Amendment confrontationThe Confrontation Clause ensures a criminal defendant's right to face and cross-examine witnesses. (对质条款) issues because the criminal defendant had a prior opportunity to cross-examine her.

(Choice B) A criminal defendant has no right to prevent the use of his spouse's testimony against him in a criminal case. Instead, under the spousal-immunity privilegeAllows a witness-spouse to refuse to testify against the defendant-spouse in a criminal trial. (配偶免证权), a criminal defendant's current spouse may refuse to testify against the defendant about events that occurred before or during the marriage.

(Choice C) A statement made by a person identified with a party—ie, an agent, employee, or person authorized to speak on that party's behalf—may fall within the hearsay exclusion for an opposing party's statementA statement made by an opposing party (or agent) offered against that party is not hearsay. (对立当事人的陈述). Since there is no evidence that the wife filled any of these roles, this is not a basis to admit her prior testimony.

📌 Educational Objective

The hearsay exception for former testimony allows admission of testimony (1) given at a trial, hearing, or deposition in the same case or a different proceeding that involved similar parties and issues and (2) offered against a party who had an opportunity and similar motive to develop that testimony through direct or cross-examination.

📚 References
  • Fed. R. Evid. 804(b)(1) (hearsay exception for former testimony).
questions.zh-question:
一名被告因破产欺诈被起诉。该被告现已故的妻子，曾在涉及类似问题的早期破产程序中，作出了对被告不利的证言。尽管当时对该妻子进行了交叉询问，但即使有重要的弹劾证据，被告方也未尽力去质疑其证词的可信度。在这次的欺诈案审判中，检察官提议将被告妻子在破产程序中所作的证言作为证据采纳。

该证据是否可以采纳？

zh-choices.A: 不可以，因为该证言属于传闻证据，且不符合任何例外情况。
zh-choices.B: 不可以，因为在刑事案件中，被告有权阻止其配偶的证言被用作对其不利的证据。
zh-choices.C: 可以，因为这是由与一方当事人有关联的人所作的陈述。
zh-choices.D: 可以，根据传闻证据例外中的先前证言规则。

questions.zh-explanation:
MBE 考点解析

Evidence: Hearsay - Declarant Unavailable as a Witness

本题真正考的是

一句话定位考点

本题真正考的是：无法出庭的声明人（unavailable declarant）的先前证言（former testimony）能不能按 FRE 804(b)(1) 直接进庭。

三秒认题路径：

死亡 → 先前证言 → 同类争点 → 曾能交叉询问 → 可采

核心法律规则

只抓这条规则就够了

先前证言（former testimony）是 hearsay 的例外之一；如果陈述人现在因死亡等原因无法出庭（unavailable），而这段证言是在先前的审判、听证或证言笔录（trial, hearing, or deposition）里说的，就可能进来。

关键还要看：这份证言是拿来对付那个当时有机会、而且有相似动机去质询（opportunity and similar motive）的人。考场意思：你不是看他当时有没有“认真问”，而是看他当时有没有机会问、也有没动力问。

这题里，妻子已经死亡，且她在之前的破产程序里讲过同类争点；被告当时也能交叉询问，所以 804(b)(1) 直接打开。

核心判例： FRE 804(b)(1) 这条规则本身就是本题答案：先前证言只要满足“无法出庭 + 先前场合 + 相似争点 + 曾有机会且相似动机质询”，就可采。

思维导图

先看这句：现在要拿来用的是不是“死者妻子之前说过的话”？
1.她已死亡 → 无法出庭（unavailable）成立。
2.那段话来自先前破产程序 → 属于先前证言（former testimony）。
3.先前程序和本案有相似争点，被告当时也能交叉询问 → opportunity and similar motive满足。
卡死点：这题不要求你证明当时问得很彻底，只要“有机会且有相似动机”就够。
结论：证言可采，选 D。

考点陷阱

你可能会想：既然丈夫当年没有认真拿出弹劾材料，证词就不该进来。

但考试真正问的是：当时有没有机会和相似动机去质询，不是他后来有没有把证人“打得很狠”。

司法考试看的是「法律程序上能不能救济」，不是「物理上的秘密有没有泄露」。

正确答案与干扰项排除

为什么选 D？

题干有已死亡 + 先前破产程序中的同类证言，而且被告当时能交叉询问，正好落进 FRE 804(b)(1)。

❌ 概念混淆 | 规则渊源误判

✕ A: 把 hearsay 当成绝对禁入，忘了先前证言有明确例外。

❌ 法律适用 | 配偶特权误套

✕ B: 把配偶能否作证和spousal-immunity privilege 混成“被告可阻止使用”。

❌ 事实误判 | 身份要件偷换

✕ C: 误把妻子说成opposing party 的代理人，但题干根本没这层身份。

这题建议用什么方法？

先抓“人是否无法出庭”，再查“先前场合 + 相似动机 + 曾可交叉询问”。

考场速记

记忆口诀：死亡或其他无法出庭 + 先前审判/听证/证言 + 相似争点 + 曾有机会质询，就先想 FRE 804(b)(1)。

这题一句话收尾：看机会，不看认真程度；看同类争点，不看故事有多惨。

question_analysis.skill_tested: apply the former testimony hearsay exception

reason.en: Establishes the threshold requirement of declarant unavailability under FRE 804.
reason.zh: 确立了联邦证据规则第804条下声明人不可出庭的前置条件。

reason.en: Indicates the testimony was given in a prior judicial proceeding.
reason.zh: 表明该证言是在先前的司法程序中作出的。

reason.en: Satisfies the requirement that the prior proceeding involved similar issues to ensure similar motive.
reason.zh: 满足先前程序涉及相似争点的要求，以确保存在相似的盘问动机。

reason.en: Shows the defendant had an opportunity to develop the testimony in the prior proceeding.
reason.zh: 表明被告在先前程序中拥有对证言进行质证和追问的机会。

keywords.text: no serious effort was made to challenge her credibility

reason.en: Serves as a distractor; having the opportunity and similar motive is sufficient even if unused.
reason.zh: 起到干扰项作用；只要有盘问机会和相似动机即可，不要求在先前程序中实际进行弹劾。

label.zh: 无传闻证据例外之干扰项

reason.en: Fails to recognize that former testimony is an applicable hearsay exception.
reason.zh: 未能识别出先前证言属于可适用的传闻证据例外。

B.text: prevent use of his spouse's testimony

reason.en: Spousal immunity belongs to the witness-spouse and only applies if they are currently married and the witness refuses to testify.
reason.zh: 配偶免证权由证人配偶享有，且仅在当前婚姻存续且证人拒绝出庭作证时适用。

C.text: statement by a person identified with a party

label.zh: 对立当事人陈述不适用

questions.subject: Evidence
questions.question:
A defendant is on trial for knowing possession of a stolen television. The defendant claims that the television was a gift from a friend, who has disappeared. The defendant seeks to testify that he was present when the friend told her neighbor that the television had been given to the friend by her mother.
Is the defendant's testimony about the friend's statement to the neighbor admissible?

choices.A: No, because the defendant has not presented evidence of circumstances that clearly corroborate the statement.
choices.B: No, because the friend's statement is hearsay not within any exception.
choices.C: Yes, as nonhearsay evidence of the defendant's belief that the friend owned the television.
choices.D: Yes, under the hearsay exception for statements affecting an interest in property.

questions.explanation:
Admissibility of statements
Made at current trial or hearing?
Offered for the truth asserted therein?
Hearsay exception or exclusion applies?
Inadmissible
hearsay statement
Probative value substantially outweighed by certain dangers? (eg, prejudicial effect)
Inadmissible
statement
Admissible
statement

Hearsay—an out-of-court statement offered to prove the truth of the matter asserted therein—is inadmissible absent an exception. Therefore, a statement offered for another purpose—eg, to show the statement's effect on the listener—is not hearsay and is generally admissible.

Here, the defendant is on trial for knowingly possessing a stolen television that he claims was gifted to him by his friend. The defendant seeks to testify that he overheard his friend say that her mother had given her the television. Although this is an out-of-court statement, it is not hearsay. That is because the statement is being offered to prove that the defendant believed that the friend owned the television before giving it to him (effect on listener)—not that the friend had actually owned it (the matter asserted) (Choice B). Therefore, the defendant's testimony is admissible nonhearsay evidence.

(Choice A) Unlike other hearsay exceptions, a statement against interest is the only hearsay exception that must be supported by corroborating evidence—but only if the statement is offered in a criminal case and exposes the declarant to criminal liability. This exception does not apply here because the friend's statement (1) is not hearsay and (2) does not expose her to criminal liability.

(Choice D) The hearsay exception for statements affecting an interest in property applies when (1) a statement appears in a document, (2) the statement relates to the document's purpose, and (3) later dealings with the property are consistent with the statement's truth. This exception is not applicable here because the friend's statement is not hearsay and did not appear in a document (since she told her neighbor).

📌 Educational Objective

Hearsay is an out-of-court statement offered to prove the truth of the matter asserted therein. An out-of-court statement that is offered for another purpose (eg, to show its effect on the listener) is not hearsay and is generally admissible.

📚 References
  • Fed. R. Evid. 801(c) (hearsay definition).
  • Fed. R. Evid. 802 (rule against hearsay).

questions.zh-explanation:
MBE 考点解析

Evidence: Hearsay - What Is Hearsay

本题真正考的是

一句话定位考点

本题真正考的是：传闻（hearsay）是不是被拿来证明“话里那件事真的发生过”；如果只是证明听到这句话后形成了某种认知，就不是传闻。

三秒认题路径：

场外话 → 证明真伪？ → 否，听者反应 → 非传闻 → 可采

核心法律规则

传闻（hearsay）是庭外陈述（out-of-court statement）拿来证明陈述内容为真的时候，才会撞上 传闻规则（rule against hearsay）。考场意思：你如果不是要证明“这话是真的”，而是要证明这话对听者产生了什么影响，就不算传闻。

对听者的影响（effect on the listener）是本题关键。考场意思：这里不是在证明朋友真的拥有电视，而是在证明被告听到那句话后，才会相信朋友有权把电视送给他，所以这段话可作为非传闻证据使用。

核心判例： Fed. R. Evid. 801(c) 和 802 锁定本题：先看是不是拿来证明真伪，不是的话就不进传闻门槛。

思维导图

这句庭外话，是不是拿来证明“话里那件事是真的”？
是 → 传闻，继续问：有无例外/排除？
若没有例外 → 不可采
否 → 不是传闻，直接看用途
本题用途：证明被告听到后形成“我以为朋友有权送我电视”的认知
卡死结论：不是为了证明朋友真的拥有电视 → 可采的非传闻证据
陷阱：别把“听起来像在讲所有权”误当成“就是要证明所有权是真的”

考点陷阱

你可能会想：朋友在说“电视是我妈给我的”，听上去就是在主张所有权，所以一定是传闻。

但考试真正问的是：这句话在本题里是拿来证明被告当时为什么会相信朋友能把电视送给他，而不是拿来证明朋友真的有所有权。

司法考试看的是「法律程序上能不能救济」，而不是「物理上的秘密有没有泄露」。本题同理，看的是证据用途，不是故事本身多像“事实真相”。

正确答案与干扰项排除

为什么选 C？

题干中的 the defendant believed 是关键：这句话是用来证明被告为何相信朋友能送电视，不是证明朋友真的拥有电视，所以不是传闻。

❌ 概念混淆 | 规则渊源误判

✕ A: 把 corroborate 乱搬来，这题根本不是在考补强。

❌ 法律适用 | 传闻定义错套

✕ B: 只看到庭外陈述就下结论，漏掉了“拿来证明什么”这一步。

❌ 事实误判 | 书面要件偷换

✕ D: 把 interest in property 当万能出口，但题干根本不是那类文书证据。

这题建议用什么方法？

先问“这句话是拿来证明真伪，还是拿来证明听者反应”，再决定要不要进传闻规则。

考场速记

记住一句：庭外话 + 证明真伪 = 传闻；庭外话 + 证明听者反应/效果 = 非传闻。本题的秒杀点就是“effect on the listener”。

questions.subject: Evidence
questions.question:
At the trial of a contract dispute, the plaintiff has offered to testify to what she heard the defendant say in a private conversation between the two of them, which the plaintiff secretly recorded on an audiotape that she did not offer in evidence.
Is the plaintiff's testimony admissible?

choices.A: No, because of the plaintiff's deception, even if the recording was not illegal.
choices.B: No, because the statement must be proved by introduction of the audiotape itself.
choices.C: Yes, because the original document rule does not apply to audiotapes.
choices.D: Yes, because the plaintiff has personal knowledge of the statement of a party-opponent.

questions.explanation:
Exclusion of relevant evidence
(FRE 402)
Relevant?
Makes material fact more
or less probable
No ➔ Inadmissible
Other basis for exclusion?
No ➔ Admissible
Constitution
  • Illegal search
  • Miranda violation
  • Etc.
Law
  • Testimony in bankruptcy case is inadmissible in criminal case
  • Refusal of visa is inadmissible
  • Etc.
Rule
  • Hearsay
  • Privilege
  • Etc.
Inadmissible

A witness may testify to any relevant matter about which he/she has personal knowledge so long as that testimony is not excluded by a specific rule, law, or constitutional provision. For example, hearsay—ie, an out-of-court statement offered to prove the truth of the matter asserted therein—is generally inadmissible even if it is relevant. But some out-of-court statements are considered nonhearsay and are admissible for their truth. This includes statements made by and offered against a party-opponent.

Here, the plaintiff sought to testify about what the defendant said in their private conversation. This conversation presumably pertained to the disputed contract, thereby making the defendant's out-of-court statement relevant. And since (1) the plaintiff has personal knowledge about that statement and (2) the statement was made by and is offered against the defendant (nonhearsay), the plaintiff's testimony about the statement is admissible.

(Choice A) A statement by an opposing party is admissible even if it was obtained deceptively—eg, by secretly recording a conversation.

(Choices B & C) The original document (ie, best evidence) rule requires that a party produce an original or reliable duplicate to prove the contents of a writing, photograph, or recording. But here, no such original or duplicate is needed since the plaintiff is seeking to testify to her personal knowledge of the defendant's statement—not to what she heard on the audiotape.

📌 Educational Objective

A witness may testify to any relevant matter about which he/she has personal knowledge so long as that testimony is not excluded by a specific rule, law, or constitutional provision (eg, the hearsay rule). And statements made by and offered against an opposing party are considered nonhearsay and, if relevant, are admissible for their truth.

📚 References
  • Fed. R. Evid. 801 (nonhearsay statements).

questions.zh-explanation:
MBE 考点解析

Evidence: Hearsay - What Is Not Hearsay

本题真正考的是

一句话定位考点

本题真正考的是：证人亲耳听到对方当事人说的话后，能不能凭自己的亲身感知作证，而不是一定要把录音带本身拿出来。

三秒认题路径：

亲耳听到 → 对方当事人 → 非传闻 → 个人知情 → 可采

核心法律规则

亲身知情（personal knowledge） 的证人，只要所述内容相关，就可以作证，前提是没有被具体规则挡住。传闻（hearsay） 是把庭外陈述拿来证明其真实性，所以一般排除；但对方当事人陈述（statement of a party-opponent） 不是传闻，考试上意思就是：拿来对付对方，可以直接用。

这里，原告要讲的是她亲耳听到被告在私下谈话里说了什么，她有自己的亲身知情，所以不需要先把录音带本身作为唯一证明工具。最佳证据规则（best evidence rule） 只卡“要证明录音内容”时的原件问题；本题不是在证明录音本身的内容，而是在证明她听见的那句话。

核心判例： Fed. R. Evid. 801 的对方当事人陈述规则锁定结论：被告自己说的话，被原告转述，且是拿来对付被告，能进。

思维导图

先看：原告是在讲“自己听见的被告原话”吗？
是
→ 她有个人知情（personal knowledge），先过能力门槛。
再问
→ 这句话是对方当事人陈述（statement of a party-opponent），不是传闻。
卡死点
不能把 best evidence rule 硬搬来：本题不是在证明录音内容，只是在证人转述亲耳听见的陈述。
结论
→ 证词可采，选 D。

考点陷阱

你可能会想：既然有录音（audiotape），那就该先交原件，不能直接说出来。

但考试真正问的是：证人自己是否亲耳听到并且能转述这句对方当事人陈述（statement of a party-opponent）。

司法考试看的是「法律程序上能不能救济」，而不是「物理上的秘密有没有泄露」。这里同样看的是“要证明什么”，不是“手里有没有录音”。

正确答案与干扰项排除

为什么选 D？

题干的关键是原告亲耳听见被告说话，属于personal knowledge；而被告的话又是对方当事人陈述，能直接作为非传闻使用。

❌ 概念混淆 | 规则渊源误判

✕ A: 把secretly recording当成致命问题，忽略了对方当事人陈述本来就可采。

❌ 法律适用 | 原件要求误判

✕ B: 误以为一定要先放录音原件，实际上她是在讲自己听见的话，不是在证明录音内容。

❌ 事实误判 | 录音对象偷换

✕ C: 把original document规则套到口头陈述上，题干根本不是写字、照片或录音内容之争。

这题建议用什么方法？

先分清“亲耳听见的原话”还是“要证明录音内容”，再判断是不是对方当事人陈述。

考场速记

记住一句：亲耳听见 + 对方说的 + 拿来对付对方，通常就是非传闻，可以直接进题。

questions.subject: Evidence
questions.question:
A hotel sued a motel for infringement of the hotel's trade name. To establish a likelihood of name confusion, the hotel offers a series of memoranda which it had asked its employees to prepare at the end of each day listing instances during the day in which telephone callers, cab drivers, customers, and others had confused the two names.
Are the memoranda admissible?

choices.A: No, because they are hearsay not within any exception.
choices.B: No, because they are more unfairly prejudicial and confusing than probative.
choices.C: Yes, because they are past recollection recorded.
choices.D: Yes, because they are records of regularly conducted business activity.

questions.explanation:
Hearsay
Out-of-court statement offered for
truth of matter asserted therein
Inadmissible unless
Excluded (ie, nonhearsay)
Declarant-witness
  • Prior inconsistent statement
  • Prior consistent statement for rehabilitation
  • Prior identification
Party-opponent
  • Made or adopted by party
  • Made by agent, employee, coconspirator, or authorized person
Excepted
Unavailable declarant
  • Former testimony
  • Dying declaration
  • Statement against interest
  • Personal/family history
  • Against party that wrongly caused declarant's absence
Other inherently reliable statements
  • Present sense impression
  • Then-existing state of mind
  • Etc.
Admissible

Hearsay is an out-of-court statement (eg, the memoranda) offered to prove the truth of the matter asserted therein (eg, that the motel was often confused with the hotel). Such statements are inadmissible unless excludedHearsay Exclusion
Statements that are defined as nonhearsay under the Federal Rules of Evidence (e.g., prior statements of a declarant-witness, party-opponent admissions).传闻排除（非传闻） or exceptedHearsay Exception
Hearsay statements that are admissible under exceptions (e.g., excited utterances, business records, dying declarations).传闻例外 from the rule against hearsay. One exception raised here applies to records of regularly conducted business activity—ie, business records that are:

  • made at or near the time of the recorded event (or act, condition, opinion, diagnosis)
  • made by or based on information from someone with personal knowledge of that event and
  • made and kept as a regular practice in the course of regularly conducted business activities.

But records made in preparation for litigation do not fall under this exception. And since the hotel created the memoranda to later establish a likelihood of name confusion at trial, this exception is inapplicable (Choice D).

Another hearsay exception raised here applies to past recollection recorded (ie, recorded recollectionRecorded Recollection (FRE 803(5))
An exception for a record about a matter the witness once knew but now cannot recall well enough to testify fully and accurately.过去回忆记录). Under this exception, a record may be read into evidence if:

  • a witness once knew the recorded information but cannot recall it at trial
  • the witness made or adopted the record when the matter was fresh in his/her mind and
  • the record accurately reflects the witness's personal knowledge at the time it was made.

Here, there are no facts to support the above requirements, so this exception is also inapplicable (Choice C). And since the memoranda are not otherwise excluded or excepted from hearsay, they are inadmissible.

(Choice B) Relevant evidence should be excluded if its probative value is substantially outweighed by certain dangers—including unfair prejudice and confusing the issues. Here, the memoranda are highly probative because they concern the central issue in the case (name confusion) and pose no danger of unfair prejudice or confusion. But the memoranda remain inadmissible as hearsay not within any exception or exclusion.

📌 Educational Objective

Records made in anticipation of litigation fall outside the business records exception to the hearsay rule. And a record may not be admitted under the recorded recollection exception unless a witness who once knew the recorded information cannot recall it at trial.

📚 References
  • Fed. R. Evid. 803(5) (hearsay exception – recorded recollection).
  • Fed. R. Evid. 803(6) (hearsay exception – business records).
questions.zh-question:
一家酒店以其商号被侵犯为由，起诉了一家汽车旅馆。为证明名称存在混淆的可能性，该酒店提供了一系列备忘录。酒店要求其员工在每天结束时准备这些备忘录，列出当天电话来电者、出租车司机、顾客及其他人将两家名称混淆的事例。

这些备忘录是否可采纳？

zh-choices.A: 不可采纳，因为它们是传闻证据，且不符合任何例外情况。
zh-choices.B: 不可采纳，因为它们的不公正偏见和混淆性超过了其证明价值。
zh-choices.C: 可采纳，因为它们是过去记录的追忆（past recollection recorded）。
zh-choices.D: 可采纳，因为它们是日常业务活动记录。

questions.zh-explanation:
MBE 考点解析

Evidence: Hearsay - Declarant's Availability Immaterial

本题真正考的是

一句话定位考点

本题真正考的是：这组日常备忘录是不是 传闻（hearsay），以及能不能被 business records 或 recorded recollection 拉进来。

三秒认题路径：

场外陈述 → 想证明真 → 先看传闻 → 再查例外 → 这题不进

核心法律规则

只抓这题要用的规则

传闻（hearsay）就是“庭外说的话”拿来证明它说的内容是真的；默认不能进，除非先被排除在传闻之外，或者落进例外。这里的备忘录是酒店员工事后写来证明“名字经常被混淆”，所以它就是传闻。

业务记录（business records）考场意思：要 at or near the time 记、靠有个人知情的人提供、而且是日常营业中的固定做法；为打官司临时整理的不算。过去回忆记录（recorded recollection）考场意思：必须是证人曾经知道、现在记不清、并且在记忆新鲜时做成或认可的记录；本题没有这个基础。

核心判例： 本题不靠特定判例，直接卡住 FRE 803(5) 和 803(6) 的要件：为诉讼准备的备忘录，不是合格业务记录，也不是可读入的过去回忆记录。

思维导图

这份备忘录要不要进证据？
先问：是不是 庭外陈述（out-of-court statement），还要拿来证明“名字混淆”是真的？
是 → 先落进 传闻（hearsay）
再查例外 1：业务记录（business records） 需要日常营业中按时制作；prepared for litigation 直接卡死。
再查例外 2：过去回忆记录（recorded recollection） 需要“曾知情 + 现记不清 + 当时确认准确”。
本题缺少这两组基础事实 → 不能套进例外
结论：不可采，选 A。

考点陷阱

你可能会想：这只是员工每天记下来的 memoranda，看起来很“正规”，应该能进。

但考试真正问的是：它是不是为证明“真的混淆”而拿来用的庭外陈述；一旦是，就先掉进传闻坑，再看有没有例外。

司法考试看的是「法律程序上能不能救济」，而不是「这份纸面记录看起来有没有商业味道」。

正确答案与干扰项排除

为什么选 A？

题干 为证明名字混淆而提交，就是庭外陈述拿来证明其内容为真；又不符合业务记录或过去回忆记录的要件，所以排除。

❌ 概念混淆 | 403裁量误判

✕ B: 把 unfairly prejudicial 当主线了，题目先问传闻能不能进。

❌ 法律适用 | 旧记忆套错

✕ C: 以为 past recollection recorded 只要写过就行，题干没给“现记不清”。

❌ 事实误判 | 事后整理误读

✕ D: 把 business activity 看成日常记录，但这是为起诉临时做的。

这题建议用什么方法？

先定它是不是拿来证明真，再把业务记录和过去回忆记录两条例外逐项卡死。

考场速记

记忆口诀：先问“是不是庭外话拿来证明真”，再问“有没有例外”。本题看到 为诉讼准备（prepared for litigation），就先别往 business records 上贴。

questions.subject: Evidence
questions.question:
A plaintiff sued a defendant for injuries sustained in an automobile collision. During the plaintiff's hospital stay, a staff physician examined the plaintiff's X-rays and said to the plaintiff, "You have a fracture of two vertebrae, C4 and C5." An intern who was accompanying the physician on her rounds immediately wrote the diagnosis on the plaintiff's hospital record.
At trial, the hospital records custodian testifies that the plaintiff's hospital record was made and kept in the ordinary course of the hospital's business.
Is the entry reporting the physician's diagnosis admissible?

choices.A: No, because no foundation has been laid for the physician's competence as an expert.
choices.B: No, because the physician's opinion is based upon data that are not in evidence.
choices.C: Yes, as a record of regularly conducted business activity.
choices.D: Yes, as a statement of then-existing physical condition.

questions.explanation:
Business records hearsay exception
(FRE 803(6))
Business record admissible if it was:
  • made at or near time of recorded event (or act, opinion, condition, diagnosis)
  • made by or based on information from someone with personal knowledge and
  • made & kept as a regular practice in the course of regularly conducted business activities
FRE = Federal Rule of Evidence.

Under the hearsay rule, out-of-court statements (eg, entries in a hospital record) are generally inadmissible when offered to prove the truth of the matter asserted therein (eg, patient has two fractured vertebrae). However, one hearsay exception applies to business records that were:

  • made at or near the time of the recorded event (or act, condition, opinion, diagnosis)
  • made by or based on information from someone with personal knowledge of that event and
  • made and kept as a regular practice in the course of regularly conducted business activities.

Hospitals create and maintain patient records as a regular practice in the regular course of hospital business. They are created near the time of the recorded event (eg, patient exam) and are made by or based on information from someone with personal knowledge of the event (eg, physician, nurse, intern). As a result, the entry in the plaintiff's hospital record reporting the physician's diagnosis is admissible under the business records hearsay exception.

(Choices A & B) A witness is only qualified to provide expert testimony if the witness has specialized knowledge, skill, experience, training, or education in the relevant field. But here, there is no need to lay such a foundation for the physician's expertise since she is not giving expert testimony. And even if she were, the facts/data underlying her opinion need not be in evidence (or even admissible) if other experts would reasonably rely thereon.

(Choice D) Statements made by a patient (or other declarant) regarding his/her then-existing physical condition (eg, pain, bodily health) are excepted from hearsay. But here, the physician's diagnosis of the patient's condition does not fall within this exception.

📌 Educational Objective

Business records are excepted from hearsay if they were (1) made near the time of the recorded event, (2) made by or based on information from one with personal knowledge, and (3) made and kept as a regular practice in the course of regular business activities.

📚 References
  • Fed. R. Evid. 803(6) (business record).
questions.zh-question:
一名原告因在一场车祸中受伤而起诉一名被告。原告住院期间，一位主治医生检查了原告的X光片，并对原告说：“你的C4和C5两节椎骨骨折了。”一位陪同该医生查房的实习医生立即将该诊断写在了原告的医院记录上。

在审判中，医院记录保管人作证称，原告的医院记录是在医院的日常业务过程中制作和保存的。

报告医生诊断的这项记录是否可采纳为证据？

zh-choices.A: 否，因为尚未为该医生作为专家的能力奠定基础。
zh-choices.B: 否，因为该医生的意见所依据的数据并未作为证据提交。
zh-choices.C: 是，作为日常商业活动记录。
zh-choices.D: 是，作为当时存在的身体状况的陈述。

questions.zh-explanation:
MBE 考点解析

Evidence: Hearsay - Declarant's Availability Immaterial

本题真正考的是

一句话定位考点

本题真正考的是：医院里“诊断写进病历”能不能用 商业记录例外（business records exception） 进入证据，而不是医生够不够资格当专家。

三秒认题路径：

病历记录 → 近时制作 → 个人知识 → 常规保存 → 能采

核心法律规则

商业记录例外（FRE 803(6)） 要求：记录要在事件发生时或附近制作，要么由有 个人知识（personal knowledge） 的人提供信息，要么基于这种信息，还要在日常经营中作为常规做法制作并保存。

医院病历通常符合这三个点，所以医师当场给出的诊断写入病历后，通常能作为 商业记录（business record） 采纳。

这里不需要先证明医生是专家，因为这题问的是病历能不能进证据，不是让医生出庭作 专家证言（expert testimony）。

核心判例： 无需专门记案名；本题直接套用 FRE 803(6) 的病历规则即可。

思维导图

先看：这句话是不是庭外陈述，要拿来证明“病人有两节椎骨骨折”？
是 先落入传闻；接着找例外。
例外 商业记录例外（FRE 803(6)） ① 近时制作 病人在住院期间，医生看完 X 光就下诊断，符合。 ② 个人知识 医师亲自检查 X 光并作诊断，信息源头有个人知识。 ③ 常规保存 医院例行制作并保存病历，符合常规经营。
卡死点：不是“医生是不是专家”，而是“病历是否是商业记录”。
结论 进入证据的，是病历里的诊断记录，不是医生当庭作专家意见。
答案落点：C

考点陷阱

你可能会想：既然是医生写的诊断，那是不是要先证明他有 expert qualifications？

但考试真正问的是：这条诊断能不能靠 business records 进去，不是在考医生自己当庭讲医学意见。

司法考试看的是「证据程序上能不能救济」，而不是「医生当时是不是专家身份」。

正确答案与干扰项排除

为什么选 C？

题干里 hospital record 是医院按常规制作并保存的病历，且诊断来自医生亲自检查 X 光后的记录，正好落进 商业记录例外（business records exception）。

❌ 概念混淆 | 规则渊源误判

✕ A: 把病历问题硬扯成 expert testimony 了。

❌ 法律适用 | 中间要件误判

✕ B: 误以为诊断要靠底层数据先进证据，忽略了病历本身的例外。

❌ 事实误判 | 记录主体偷换

✕ D: 把医生的诊断当成病人自己的 then-existing physical condition 了。

这题建议用什么方法？

先抓传闻例外，再对照“三件套”：近时、个人知识、常规保存。

考场速记

记住一句：病历可采，不看宣誓身份，先看 803(6) 三要件。遇到病历、化验单、护理记录，先问“是不是医院常规业务里做出来的”。

questions.subject: Evidence
questions.question:
Several defendants, senior executives of a corporation, were charged with securities fraud.
The government called as a witness another executive of the corporation, who had not been charged and who had been given immunity from prosecution, to authenticate handwritten notes that she had made after meetings of the corporation's management team at which the alleged fraud was discussed. The witness testified that she had prepared the notes on her own initiative to help her remember what had happened at the meetings. After this testimony, the government offered the notes into evidence to establish what had happened at the meetings.
Should the witness's notes be admitted?

choices.A: No, because the notes are hearsay not within any exception.
choices.B: No, because the witness's immunity agreement with the government makes her notes untrustworthy and thus substantially more prejudicial than probative.
choices.C: Yes, because they are business records.
choices.D: Yes, because they are past recollections recorded.

questions.explanation:
Business records hearsay exception
(FRE 803(6))
Out-of-court record made at or near time of
recorded event
Made by or based on information from person
with personal knowledge
Made & kept as regular practice in course of
regularly conducted business activity
Excepted from hearsay
FRE = Federal Rule of Evidence.

An out-of-court statement (eg, writing) offered for the truth of the matter asserted therein is hearsay and generally inadmissible. However, business records are excepted from the rule against hearsay if those records were:

  • made at or near the time of the recorded event (or act, condition, opinion, diagnosis)
  • made by or based on information from someone with personal knowledge of that event and
  • made and kept as a regular practice (eg, routine meeting minutes) in the course of regularly conducted activities of the business.

But an individual's personal notes (even those made in a business setting) are not the organization's regularly kept business records (Choice C). And when offered for the truth asserted, such personal notes are inadmissible hearsay unless another hearsay exceptionHearsay Exception
An out-of-court statement offered for the truth of the matter asserted that is nonetheless admissible under an exception to the hearsay rule.传闻例外 applies (not seen here).

(Choice B) The witness's immunity agreement from prosecution had no effect on the trustworthiness of her notes because she wrote them prior to the immunity agreement. Therefore, the notes are not substantially more prejudicial than probative, and this is not a basis for excluding them.

(Choice D) The past recollection recordedRecorded Recollection (FRE 803(5))
An exception for a record about a matter the witness once knew but now cannot recall well enough to testify fully and accurately.过去回忆记录 (ie, recorded recollection) hearsay exception applies to records that (1) concern a matter a witness once knew but cannot recall at trial, (2) were made or adopted by the witness when the matter was fresh in his/her mind, and (3) accurately reflect the witness's knowledge at that time. But here, the witness has not claimed that she has forgotten what happened at the meetings. And even if she had, she could only read the notes into evidence since only opposing parties could offer them as an exhibit.

📌 Educational Objective

Business records are excepted from hearsay if they were (1) made at or near the time of the recorded event, (2) made by or based on information from someone with personal knowledge, and (3) made and kept as a regular practice in the course of regular activities of the business.

📚 References
  • Fed. R. Evid. 803(6) (hearsay exception – records of a regularly conducted activity).
questions.zh-question:
几名被告，他们是一家公司的高管，被控证券欺诈罪。

政府传唤了该公司的另一名高管作为证人，该高管未被起诉并获得了检控豁免，以鉴定她在公司管理团队讨论被指控的欺诈行为的会议后所做的手写笔记。证人作证称，她主动准备这些笔记是为了帮助自己记住会议上发生的事情。在该证词之后，政府将这些笔记作为证据提交，以证明会议上发生的事情。

证人的笔记应被采纳为证据吗？

zh-choices.A: 不应采纳，因为这些笔记是传闻证据，且不属于任何例外规则的范畴。
zh-choices.B: 不应采纳，因为证人与政府的豁免协议使其笔记不可信，因此其偏见性影响实质上超过其证明价值。
zh-choices.C: 应予采纳，因为它们是商业记录。
zh-choices.D: 应予采纳，因为它们是已记录的过去记忆。

questions.zh-explanation:
MBE 考点解析

Evidence: Hearsay - Declarant's Availability Immaterial

本题真正考的是

一句话定位考点

本题真正考的是：这份会后手写笔记是不是 传闻（hearsay），以及它能不能塞进 商业记录例外（business records exception）；答案是不能。

三秒认题路径：

会后自记笔记 → 法庭要证真相 → 不是例常业务记录 → 也不是另一例外 → 选 No

核心法律规则

只抓这条就够了

传闻（hearsay）是庭外陈述拿来证明陈述内容为真，通常不能进。

商业记录例外（business records exception）要求记录是及时做的、依据有个人知识的人提供的信息，而且是企业日常业务中的常规保存记录；考场意思：企业自己真的拿来做业务的记录才更可信。

如果只是某个员工为了自己记忆写的私人笔记，即使在公司场景里写，也不自动变成企业商业记录；考场意思：个人备忘录不是组织的“常规业务档案”。

核心判例：本题不靠判例展开，直接按 FRE 803(6) 三步看：这份笔记不是公司例行保存的业务记录，所以进不去。

思维导图

先看：这份笔记是不是庭外拿来证明内容为真？
是 → 先落入 传闻（hearsay）。
再查例外 → 能不能走 商业记录例外（business records exception）？
及时性
不是公司例行流程里形成的标准业务记录。
信息来源
是她自己为了记忆而写，不是企业常规档案。
常规保存
缺少“ regularly conducted business activity ”的那层。
卡死点：私人笔记 ≠ 企业商业记录
结论 → 不进 A，应选 A。

考点陷阱

你可能会想：她在公司会议后写的，听起来就像“业务笔记”，应该能当商业记录。

但考试真正问的是：这是不是公司日常运营里固定保存的记录，而不是某个员工自己顺手记下来的私人回忆。

关键区别：公司场景不等于公司记录；她是为了自己记忆写的，不是为了企业的常规业务保存。你不能因为它“看起来很正式”就把它塞进例外。

正确答案与干扰项排除

为什么选 A？

题干 自写的会后笔记 只是个人记忆辅助，不是公司常规业务记录，所以属于传闻且没有落进例外。

❌ 概念混淆 | 可信度误判

✕ B: 把 immunity 当成笔记可信度来源，题目根本没在比这个。

❌ 法律适用 | 商业记录错套

✕ C: 看到公司会议就硬套 business records，但这是个人笔记。

❌ 事实误判 | 记忆缺失偷换

✕ D: 题干没说她忘了内容，recorded recollection 这条起不来。

这题建议用什么方法？

先判传闻，再看有没有真正的商业记录例外；别被“公司背景”带偏。

考场速记

记住一句：个人笔记（personal notes） 不是 商业记录（business records）。看到“为了自己记忆写的”，先别急着放进 FRE 803(6)。

口诀：“公司场景不等于公司记录；自己记的，多半还是传闻。”

questions.subject: Evidence
questions.question:
A defendant is on trial for the robbery of an armored bank truck. A man and his wife witnessed the robber flee from the armored truck. The man testified that the robber removed his mask and exposed his face as he fled. The man further testified that he recognized the defendant as the robber. The defendant now seeks to introduce the grand jury testimony of the man's wife, who has refused to testify at trial despite a court order requiring her to do so.
During her grand jury testimony, the wife affirmatively stated that the robber never removed his mask or exposed his face. Despite evidence to the contrary, the prosecution did not press the wife on this matter, as it had more than enough evidence linking the defendant to the robbery to secure an indictment.
If the court does not admit the wife's grand jury testimony, what is the most likely explanation?

choices.A: Grand jury testimony is specifically excluded from the definition of former testimony.
choices.B: The prosecution lacked the motive to develop the wife's testimony at the grand jury proceeding.
choices.C: The wife is available to testify at trial.
choices.D: The wife is unavailable to testify at trial.

questions.explanation:
Former testimony (FRE 804(b)(1))
Hearsay exception for unavailable declarant's testimony that:
  • was given at trial, hearing, or deposition in current case or different proceeding that involved similar parties & issues and
  • is offered against party who had opportunity & similar motive to develop testimony by direct or cross-examination
FRE = Federal Rule of Evidence.

Out-of-court statements (eg, the wife's grand jury testimony) offered to prove the truth of the matter asserted therein are generally inadmissible under the rule against hearsay. However, certain statements are excluded or excepted Excluded or Excepted: Evidence that is otherwise inadmissible hearsay may be admitted if it falls under a hearsay exclusion (e.g., opposing party statements) or hearsay exception (e.g., former testimony).

排除或例外：如果是传闻证据，但属于传闻排除（如对方当事人陈述）或传闻例外（如前供述），则可以采信。 from this rule. One hearsay exception allows admission of former testimony if:

  • the declarant is unavailable Unavailable: A declarant is unavailable if they are exempt due to privilege, refuse to testify despite a court order, testify to a lack of memory, are dead or physically/mentally ill, or cannot be procured.

    无法出庭：指陈述者因特权免责、无视法院命令拒绝作证、遗忘、死亡、身心疾病或无法传唤出庭。     —eg, the declarant refuses to testify despite a court order to do so (as seen with the wife here)
  • the testimony was given at a trial, hearing, or deposition in the current case or in a different proceeding that involved similar parties and issues and
  • the party against whom the testimony is offered had an opportunity and similar motive to develop that testimony through direct or cross-examination of the declarant.

However, this exception rarely applies to grand jury testimony because (1) a suspect/defendant is seldom present at grand jury proceedings and (2) the prosecution's motive to develop a grand jury witness's testimony is often lacking.*

Here, the wife previously testified before the grand jury that the robber did not remove his mask or expose his face. The prosecution lacked the motive to press the wife on this testimony because it had more than enough evidence to secure an indictment. And since the wife's testimony is not otherwise excluded or excepted from the hearsay rule, it is inadmissible.

*For example, motive may be lacking because other evidence is sufficient to implicate the suspect, the testimony took place early in the grand jury investigation, or a statement exculpating the suspect is a minor part of the witness's overall testimony.

(Choice A) Although the former testimony exception rarely applies to grand jury testimony because the defense can rarely show that the prosecution had a similar motive to develop the testimony, grand jury testimony is not specifically excluded from the exception.

(Choices C & D) The wife is not available to testify at trial since she refused to testify despite a court order requiring her to do so. But even when a declarant is unavailable, the declarant's statement can still be admissible if it falls within an exception or exclusion to the hearsay rule (not seen here).

📌 Educational Objective

The former testimony exception rarely applies to grand jury testimony because (1) a suspect/defendant is seldom present at grand jury proceedings and (2) the prosecution's motive to develop a witness's testimony is often lacking.

📚 References
  • Fed. R. Evid. 804(b)(1) (hearsay exception for former testimony).
questions.zh-question:
一名被告因抢劫一辆运钞车而受审。一对夫妇目睹了劫匪从运钞车逃离。该男子作证称，劫匪在逃跑时摘下了面具，露出了脸。该男子进一步作证称，他认出被告就是劫匪。被告现在寻求引入该男子妻子的**大陪审团证词 (grand jury testimony)**，尽管法院命令其出庭作证，她仍拒绝在审判中作证。
在她的大陪审团证词中，妻子明确表示劫匪从未摘下面具或露出脸。尽管有相反证据，控方并未就此事追问妻子，因为控方已有足够多的证据将被告与抢劫案联系起来，足以获得**起诉 (indictment)**。
如果法院不采纳妻子的**大陪审团证词 (grand jury testimony)**，最可能的解释是什么？

zh-choices.A: **大陪审团证词 (Grand jury testimony)** 被明确排除在**先前证词 (former testimony)** 的定义之外。
zh-choices.B: 控方在**大陪审团程序 (grand jury proceeding)** 中缺乏动机来充分发展妻子的证词。
zh-choices.C: 妻子在审判中可以出庭作证。
zh-choices.D: 妻子在审判中无法出庭作证。

questions.zh-explanation:
MBE 考点解析

Evidence: Hearsay - Former testimony; depositions

本题真正考的是

一句话定位考点

本题真正考的是：前供述（former testimony）能不能拿来替代不上庭的证人作证，关键卡在对方在先前程序里有没有机会且相似动机（opportunity and similar motive）去发展这份证言。

三秒认题路径：

听说证言 → 证人缺席 → 先前程序 → 动机不足 → 不能用

核心法律规则

规则只抓这条

前供述（former testimony）是传闻例外之一，前提是陈述人现在无法出庭（unavailable），而且这份证言曾在 trial、hearing 或 deposition 中作出。更关键的是，拿这份证言来反对的一方，之前必须有机会且相似动机（opportunity and similar motive）去直接询问或交叉询问。考试上这句话的意思很具体：不是“对方当时在场就够了”，而是“当时真的有动力把这件事问到底”。

核心判例： Mohawk Industries v. Carpenter 不适用于本题；本题锁定的是 FRE 804(b)(1) 的前供述规则：先问有没有相似动机，再决定能不能进证据。

思维导图

妻子的陪审团证言能不能进？先看她现在是不是 unavailable。
YES：她拒绝服从法庭命令作证，先满足 无法出庭（unavailability）。
下一关：这份证言是不是 former testimony，而且对方先前有机会发展它？
看两点：先前是在 grand jury；被反对的一方是检方；还要有 similar motive。
卡死点：检方当时只想拿到起诉书，不急着追问有利于被告的细节，所以没有 similar motive。
结论：虽然人是 unavailable，但前供述例外没过第二道门，证言不能进，选 B。

考点陷阱

你可能会想：她都被法院命令了还不出庭，听起来就该把先前证言放进来。

但考试真正问的是：unavailable 只过第一关，后面还要看检方在 grand jury 里有没有真的想把这件事问透。

司法考试看的是「法律程序上能不能救济」，不是「当时有没有把秘密说出去」。

正确答案与干扰项排除

为什么选 B？

妻子虽属 unavailable，但检方在 grand jury 里没有足够的 similar motive 去追问她的否认证言，所以前供述例外进不来。

❌ 概念混淆 | 规则渊源误判

✕ A: 把 grand jury 当成天生排除项了，规则里根本没有这条。

❌ 事实误判 | 出庭资格偷换

✕ C: 她已拒绝服从法庭命令，不能算可出庭证人。

❌ 法律适用 | 无法状态误判

✕ D: 只盯着 unavailable，却忘了还要过相似动机这关。

这题建议用什么方法？

程序顺序先走：先确认 unavailable，再查 prior party 的 similar motive，缺一就出局。

考场速记

记住一句：前供述（former testimony）不是“以前说过就能用”，而是“以前说过，而且对方当时真的有动力问到底”。

grand jury 常见陷阱就是：证人不出庭 ≠ 证言自动可采。先盯 similar motive，再决定能不能进。

questions.subject: Evidence
questions.question:
A defendant, the mayor of a city, ran an illegal gambling business with his ruthless business partner. The defendant was charged with dishonest and fraudulent dealings in violation of a federal statute and conspiracy to obstruct law enforcement. At trial, the prosecutor called a witness, a secretary working at the police department. The witness intends to testify that an investigating officer told her that he was afraid to arrest the mayor's business partner because certain officers had been punished for arresting members of the business partner's operation in the past.
Is the witness's testimony admissible?

choices.A: No, because it is hearsay not within any exception.
choices.B: No, because the statement was not made while under the stress of a startling event.
choices.C: Yes, as a statement by the officer of his then-existing emotional condition.
choices.D: Yes, provided that the officer is unavailable to testify.

questions.explanation:
Then-existing state of mind hearsay exception
(FRE 803(3))
Type of statement Examples Admissibility
State of mind Motive, intent, plan Admissible as substantive evidence
Emotional or physical condition Fear, pain, bodily health
Memory or belief Reflection on prior event or belief about matter Inadmissible unless related to declarant's will
FRE = Federal Rule of Evidence.

The rule against hearsay prohibits the admission of a statement made outside the present proceeding that is offered for the truth of the matter asserted therein unless an exception or exclusionException or Exclusion / 例外或排除Exceptions (e.g., FRE 803/804) or exclusions (e.g., FRE 801(d)) allow otherwise inadmissible hearsay to be admitted. applies. One hearsay exception permits admission of a statement concerning the declarant's then-existing state of mind (eg, motive, intent, plan) OR emotional/physical condition (eg, mental feeling, pain, bodily health).

Here, the witness seeks to testify that an officer said that he was afraid to arrest the mayor's business partner because certain officers had been punished for arresting members of the business partner's operation in the past. This out-of-court statement is hearsay since it is offered for its truth—to prove that the officer was afraid of being punished if he arrested the business partner. But since the statement concerns the officer's then-existing emotional condition—his fear of punishment—it is excepted from hearsay and is therefore admissible (Choice C).

(Choice B) An excited utteranceExcited Utterance / 激动言辞A statement relating to a startling event or condition, made while the declarant was under the stress of excitement caused by the event or condition. is a hearsay exception for a statement that relates to, and was made while under the stress of, a startling event or condition (eg, had the officer blurted out the statement after witnessing a punishment). But though the officer's statement was not made under the stress of excitement, it is still admissible as a then-existing emotional condition.

(Choice D) Some hearsay exceptions only apply if the declarant is unavailableDeclarant Unavailable / 陈述者无法出庭A requirement under FRE 804 where the declarant cannot testify due to privilege, refusal, death, or physical/mental illness. to testify. But the exception for a then-existing emotional condition is not one of those exceptions. Therefore, the witness's statement would be admissible under this exception regardless of whether the officer is available.

📌 Educational Objective

Statements regarding a declarant's then-existing state of mind (eg, motive, intent, plan) or emotional/physical condition (eg, mental feeling, pain, bodily health) are excepted from the rule against hearsay.

📚 References
  • Fed. R. Evid. 803(3) (hearsay exception for a declarant's then-existing emotional condition).
questions.zh-question:
一名被告，某市市长，与其心狠手辣的商业伙伴共同经营非法赌博业务。该被告被指控违反联邦法规从事不诚实和欺诈性交易，并合谋妨碍执法。庭审时，检察官传唤了一名在警察局工作的秘书作为证人。该证人准备作证称，一名调查警官告诉她，他不敢逮捕市长的商业伙伴，因为过去曾有警官因逮捕该商业伙伴团伙的成员而受到惩罚。

该证人的证言是否可采纳？

zh-choices.A: 否，因为该证言属于传闻证据，且不符合任何例外情况。
zh-choices.B: 否，因为该陈述并非在惊吓事件的压力下作出。
zh-choices.C: 是，因为这是警官关于其当时心绪状况的陈述。
zh-choices.D: 是，前提是该警官无法出庭作证。

questions.zh-explanation:
MBE 考点解析

Evidence: Hearsay - What Is Hearsay

本题真正考的是

一句话定位考点

本题真正考的是：一名证人转述警官当场说自己“害怕”的话，能否作为 then-existing state of mind（当时心态）例外进法庭。

三秒认题路径：

转述旧话 → 证明其怕 → 心态例外 → 非传闻 → 直接采信

核心法律规则

传闻（hearsay）是庭外陈述拿来证明陈述内容是真的；但 FRE 803(3) 允许引入陈述者的 then-existing state of mind，也就是动机、意图、计划，或者情绪/身体状态。fear（害怕）正是情绪状态，所以警官说“我害怕去抓人”时，这句话可以直接证明他当时真的害怕。考场意思：不是看这话有没有在惊吓现场说出，而是看它是不是在讲“我现在的心里状态”。

核心判例： FRE 803(3) 本身就是本题规则来源；它锁定“当时心态/情绪”可以进，而“回忆过去原因”通常不行。

思维导图

先看这句话是不是传闻：庭外的警官陈述，被拿来证明“他当时真的害怕” → 是。
关卡 1：它讲的是现在的情绪状态，还是过去事件回忆？
“我害怕去抓他” = 现在的 emotional condition（情绪状态） → 进 803(3)。
关键点：“过去有人受罚”只是解释恐惧来源，不是要你证明过去受罚本身是真的。
卡死点：不是 excited utterance，也不需要宣誓人 unavailable（无法出庭）。
结论：因为它是在讲“当时的怕”，所以可采，选 C。

考点陷阱

你可能会想：这句话提到了以前“有人被处罚”，像是在讲一段过去事故，所以要套 excited utterance（激动言辞）。

但考试真正问的是：这句话最重要的功能，是证明警官当时害怕，不是证明那段过去事情本身。

司法考试看的是「法律程序上能不能救济」，而不是「物理上的秘密有没有泄露」。这里也是一样，考的是能不能按 803(3) 收，不是看故事有没有吓人。

正确答案与干扰项排除

为什么选 C？

题干 I was afraid 直接点出警官当时的情绪状态，正落在 then-existing emotional condition 例外里，所以可采。

❌ 概念混淆 | 例外张冠李戴

✕ A: 你把心态例外看成“完全没例外”。

❌ 法律适用 | 激动言辞套错

✕ B: 只盯着 startling event，却忽略这题问的是当时的害怕。

❌ 事实误判 | 错加前提

✕ D: 你硬塞 unavailable 条件，但这里根本不需要。

这题建议用什么方法？

先看陈述内容是在讲“现在心态”还是“过去事实”，再决定是否直接进 803(3)。

考场速记

记忆口诀：then-existing state of mind 记三样：动机、意图、计划；情绪和身体状态也算。看到“我现在害怕、我现在想、我现在打算”，先想到 803(3)。

B.text: not made while under the stress of a startling event

questions.subject: Evidence
questions.question:
A plaintiff sued his insurance company for the proceeds of a casualty insurance policy covering his 60-foot yacht, claiming that the yacht was destroyed by an accidental fire. The company has denied liability, claiming that the plaintiff hired his friend to set the fire. In the hospital the day after the fire, the friend, who had been badly burned in the fire, said to his wife, in the presence of an attending nurse, "I was paid to set the fire." Two weeks later, the friend died of an infection resulting from the burns.
At trial, the insurance company calls the wife to testify to the friend's statement.
Is the wife's testimony admissible over the plaintiff's objection?

choices.A: No, because the marital privilege survives the communicating spouse's death.
choices.B: No, because the statement was made after the conspiracy ended.
choices.C: Yes, because it is a statement against interest.
choices.D: Yes, because it is a statement by a coconspirator.

questions.explanation:
Statement against interest
(FRE 804(b)(3))
Hearsay statement that reasonable person in unavailable declarant's position would only make if true because it:
  • is contrary to declarant's proprietary or pecuniary interest
  • tends to invalidate declarant's claim against someone else or
  • exposes declarant to civil or criminal liability
FRE = Federal Rule of Evidence.

The rule against hearsay generally bars the admission of an out-of-court statement offered to prove the truth of the matter asserted therein. But there is an exception for a statement against interest—ie, a statement that a reasonable person in the declarant's position would only have made if he/she believed it to be true because it:

  • is contrary to the declarant's proprietary or pecuniary interest
  • tends to invalidate the declarant's claim against someone else or
  • exposes the declarant to civil or criminal liability.

For this exception to apply, however, the declarant must be unavailableDeclarant Unavailable / 证人无法出庭A requirement under FRE 804 (e.g., due to death, privilege, illness, or refusal to testify) for certain hearsay exceptions to apply. as a witness (eg, deceased).

Here, the friend's out-of-court statement ("I was paid to set the fire") is hearsayHearsay / 传闻证据An out-of-court statement offered in evidence to prove the truth of the matter asserted. since it is being offered for its truth. But a reasonable person in the friend's position would only have said this if it were true since the statement exposed the friend to criminal liability for arsonArson / 纵火罪The criminal act of deliberately setting fire to property.. And since the friend is unavailable to testify (deceased), the wife's testimony as to the friend's statement is admissible under the statement against interest hearsay exception.

(Choice A) Spousal communicationsSpousal Communications / 夫妻通信特免权Protects confidential communications made during a marriage. It survives death but is destroyed by the presence of a third party. are generally privileged if they are made during a valid marriage and reasonably intended to be confidential. This marital privilege survives the communicating spouse's death. But here, confidentiality was not intended since the friend's statement to his wife was made in the nurse's presence.

(Choices B & D) An out-of-court statement made by an opposing party's coconspiratorCoconspirator Statement / 共谋者陈述An out-of-court statement by a coconspirator during and in furtherance of a conspiracy is excluded from the hearsay rule. during and in furtherance of the conspiracy is admissible nonhearsay (ie, is excluded from the hearsay rule) when offered against that party. This exclusion does not apply to the friend's statement, which was made after the conspiracy had ended. But the statement is still admissible as a statement against interest.

📌 Educational Objective

A statement against interest is a hearsay exception for statements that are so contrary to the declarant's proprietary, pecuniary, or penal interest that a reasonable person in the declarant's position would only have said it if he/she believed it to be true. But this exception only applies if the declarant is unavailable as a witness.

📚 References
  • Fed. R. Evid. 804(b)(3) (hearsay exception – statement against interest).

一名原告起诉其保险公司，要求支付为其60英尺游艇投保的意外保险单赔偿金，声称该游艇因一场意外火灾被毁。保险公司拒绝承担责任，声称是原告雇佣其朋友纵火。火灾发生第二天，在医院里，那位在火灾中被严重烧伤的朋友，当着一名值班护士的面，对他的妻子说：“有人付钱让我放火。”两周后，该朋友因烧伤引起的感染死亡。

在庭审中，保险公司传唤该妻子就其朋友的陈述作证。

即使原告提出反对，妻子的证言是否可以被采纳？

zh-choices.A: 不可以，因为夫妻特免权在作出交流的配偶死亡后仍然有效。
zh-choices.B: 不可以，因为该陈述是在共谋结束后作出的。
zh-choices.C: 可以，因为这是一个不利于己方利益的陈述。
zh-choices.D: 可以，因为这是共谋者的陈述。

questions.zh-explanation:
MBE 考点解析

Evidence: Hearsay - Declarant Unavailable as a Witness

本题真正考的是

一句话定位考点

本题真正考的是：传闻例外（hearsay exception）里，证人无法出庭（declarant unavailable）时，能不能把“我被付钱纵火”这种对自己不利的话，作为against interest（不利陈述）拿进来。

三秒认题路径：

庭外陈述 → 用来证明真话 → 证人已死亡 → 伤到自己 → 可进

核心法律规则

传闻（hearsay）是庭外陈述拿来证明其内容为真，原则上不能进。声明 against interest（statement against interest）是例外：理性人如果不是真的，通常不会说出这种会伤到自己财产、金钱或刑责的话，所以它更可信。

但这个例外有前提：宣告人（declarant）必须无法出庭（unavailable），比如已经死亡。这里朋友说“I was paid to set the fire”，这句话会把他自己直接推向纵火刑责，所以属于可采的 against interest 陈述。

核心判例： Mohawk Industries v. Carpenter 不适用本题；本题锁定的是 FRE 804(b)(3) 的不利陈述例外，而不是上诉程序。

思维导图

先问：这句庭外话是不是拿来证明“他说的是真的”？
是
再问：有没有 FRE 804(b)(3) 的入口？
1. 陈述是否不利？
“我被付钱去纵火” 会把自己送进 criminal liability
2. 宣告人是否无法出庭？
朋友后来因烧伤感染死亡，满足 unavailable
3. 结论
两关都过，妻子转述这句话可采，答案到 C。
不是
若只是拿来听个背景，就不是这道题的问法。

考点陷阱

你可能会想：既然这是在医院、又是丈夫对妻子说的，应该先想到夫妻特免权或共谋者陈述。

但考试真正问的是：这句话能不能作为不利陈述（statement against interest）进证，而不是它和婚姻、共谋有没有关系。

司法考试看的是「证据规则上能不能救济」，不是「这个人说完后多惨」。 这里最关键的不是故事悲不悲，而是这句话是不是会把说话人自己送进刑责，而且他说话时已经无法出庭。

正确答案与干扰项排除

为什么选 C？

题干 I was paid to set the fire 直接把朋友推向纵火刑责，且他后来死亡，正好落入 statement against interest 例外。

❌ 概念混淆 | 夫妻特免权误判

✕ A: 把 spousal privilege 当成关键，但有护士在场，保密性先破。

❌ 法律适用 | 共谋时点误判

✕ B: 误把 after the conspiracy 当成决定点，这题根本不用共谋规则。

❌ 事实误判 | 共谋者身份偷换

✕ D: 看到 coconspirator 就套用，但朋友这句不是为推进共谋而说。

这题建议用什么方法？

先看证人是否无法出庭，再判断这句话是不是把说话人自己推向刑责。

考场速记

记忆口诀：“先看人能不能出庭，再看话会不会害到自己。” 只要是庭外自我不利陈述，又碰上 unavailable declarant，先想 FRE 804(b)(3)。

questions.subject: Evidence
questions.question:
A defendant has been charged in federal court with tax evasion. The prosecution alleges that the defendant took money from his closely held corporation and gifted it to his ex-girlfriend in order to avoid paying taxes on the money. At trial, the defendant testified that he merely transferred the money to his ex-girlfriend to hold in trust for the corporation. The defendant further testified that, after their relationship ended and she claimed ownership of the money, he successfully sued the ex-girlfriend for return of the money. The defendant now seeks to introduce an authenticated copy of the state court civil judgment obtained against the ex-girlfriend three years ago to show that the money was not a gift to the ex-girlfriend and belonged to the corporation. The prosecution objected to admission of the state court judgment.
Should the court admit the state court judgment?

choices.A: No, because the copy of the state court judgment violates the "best evidence" rule.
choices.B: No, because the judgment is hearsay not within an exception.
choices.C: Yes, because the judgment was issued in a civil, not criminal, case.
choices.D: Yes, under the hearsay exception for statements affecting an interest in property.

questions.explanation:
Hearsay Exceptions for Records & Statements Affecting Property Interest

Hearsay exceptions for records & statements affecting property interest
(FRE 803(14)–(15))
Records Record of document that purports to affect property interest is admissible if:
  • record admitted to prove content of original recorded document, along with signing & delivery by each purported signee
  • record kept in public office and
  • statute authorizes recording such documents in that office
Statements Statement in document that purports to affect property interest is admissible if:
  • matter stated was relevant to document's purpose and
  • later dealings with property do not contradict truth of statement or purport of document
FRE = Federal Rule of Evidence.

The rule against hearsayRule Against Hearsay / 传闻规则Prohibits out-of-court statements offered to prove the truth of the matter asserted. / 禁止引入庭外陈述来证明其主张之事实的真实性。 bars the admission of out-of-court statementsOut-of-Court Statement / 庭外陈述A statement made outside of the current trial or hearing. / 在法庭审理或听证会之外所作的陈述。 (here, the state court judgment) offered to prove the truth of the matter assertedTruth of the Matter Asserted / 证明所主张事实的真实性Offering a statement to prove that the facts contained within it are true. / 提供该陈述以证明其中包含的事实为真。 therein (that the money belonged to the corporation) (Choice B). However, certain statements are excluded or exceptedExclusions & Exceptions / 排除与例外Statements that are either defined as nonhearsay (exclusions) or admissible hearsay (exceptions). / 排除在传闻之外（非传闻）或虽属传闻但可予采信的例外情形。 from this rule. For example, statements in documents that purport to affect a property interest are excepted from hearsay if:

  • the matter stated was relevant to the document's purpose and
  • later dealings with the property do not contradict the truth of the statement or the purport of the document.

Here, the state court judgment purported to affect the corporation's interest in property (money) and contained statements that were relevant to the judgment's purpose (establishing ownership of the money). Additionally, there is no indication that the money was later dealt with in a manner that was inconsistent with the judgment. Therefore, the court should admit the judgment under this hearsay exceptionHearsay Exception / 传闻证据例外A rule allowing hearsay evidence to be admitted due to circumstantial guarantees of trustworthiness. / 基于环境对可信性的保障，允许采信特定传闻证据的例外规则。.

(Choice A) The "best evidence" ruleBest Evidence Rule / 最佳证据规则Requires the production of the original writing, recording, or photograph to prove its content. / 要求提供书面材料、录音或照片的原件以证明其内容。 generally requires that an original—or a reliable duplicate—be produced to prove the contents of a writing, recording, or photograph. Therefore, the admission of an authenticated copy of the state court judgment would not violate this rule.

(Choice C) The admissibility of a judgment under the hearsay exception for statements in documents that purport to affect a property interest does not hinge on whether the judgment was entered in a civil or criminal case. Therefore, the fact that the state court judgment was issued in a civil case is not a basis for admitting it.

📌 Educational Objective

Statements in documents that purport to affect a property interest are excepted from hearsay if (1) the matter stated was relevant to the document's purpose and (2) later dealings with the property do not contradict the truth of the statement or the purport of the document.

📚 References
  • Fed. R. Evid. 803(15) (hearsay exception for statements in documents affecting a property interest).
questions.zh-question:
一名被告在联邦法院被指控逃税。检方指控称，该被告从其封闭式控股公司取走一笔钱，并将其赠与其前女友，以逃避该笔款项的税款。在审判中，被告作证称，他只是将该笔钱款转移给其前女友，以便为公司代为持有，形成信托关系。被告进一步作证称，在他们关系结束后，女方声称拥有该笔钱款，他成功起诉了前女友并要求其返还该笔钱款。被告现在试图引入三年前对前女友作出的州法院民事判决的经认证副本，以证明该笔钱款并非给前女友的赠与，而是属于该公司。检方反对采纳该州法院判决。

法院是否应采纳该州法院判决？

zh-choices.A: 不应采纳，因为该州法院判决的副本违反了“最佳证据”规则。
zh-choices.B: 不应采纳，因为该判决是传闻证据，且不属于例外情况。
zh-choices.C: 应予采纳，因为该判决与逃税问题具有相关性。
zh-choices.D: 应予采纳，根据影响财产权益的陈述的传闻证据例外规则。

questions.zh-explanation:
MBE 考点解析

Evidence: Hearsay - Other hearsay exceptions

本题真正考的是

一句话定位考点

本题真正考的是：写进判决书、而且是为证明财产权归属的州法院民事判决，能不能作为传闻例外进来。

三秒认题路径：

庭外判决 → 证明归属 → 先看传闻 → 再看财产权例外 → 选 D

核心法律规则

抓住这条规则就够了

传闻（hearsay）是庭外陈述拿来证明陈述内容为真；但影响财产权的文书陈述（statement in a document affecting a property interest）是例外，考场意思：只要文书内容和它的目的有关，而且后来对这项财产的处分没有打脸这份文书，就能进来。

这里的州法院判决本身就是在确认钱的归属，和“这笔钱属于公司”这个证明目的完全对得上；题干也没说后来对这笔钱有相反处分，所以可以用这个例外。

核心判例：Fed. R. Evid. 803(15) - 文书若是为影响财产权而作，且后续交易不反驳其内容，就可作为传闻例外采信。

思维导图

先问：这份州法院判决是不是庭外陈述？
是拿来证明“钱属于公司” → 先落入传闻规则
再问有没有 财产权例外（property-interest exception）？
检查1判决内容是否和目的相关？
相关：确认钱的归属
检查2后来对这笔钱的处理有没有反着来？
本题没有相反处分，所以第三要件也过
结论可以进入证据 → 选 D

考点陷阱

你可能会想：这就是一份civil case 判决，所以好像跟刑案没关系，或者只是副本，应该先卡在别的规则。

但考试真正问的是：它是不是符合传闻例外，而不是它来自民事还是刑事程序；司法考试看的是「法律程序上能不能救济」，而不是「物理上的秘密有没有泄露」。

正确答案与干扰项排除

为什么选 D？

题干这份state court civil judgment是为证明财产权归属而用，且没有后续相反处分，正落在影响财产权的文书陈述例外里。

❌ 概念混淆 | 规则渊源误判

✕ A: 把认证副本和best evidence混成一回事了。

❌ 法律适用 | 例外位置误判

✕ B: 只看到judgment就当作普通传闻，漏掉财产权例外。

❌ 事实误判 | 民刑区分误判

✕ C: 以为civil, not criminal 就能自动放行。

这题建议用什么方法？

先认出“庭外文书 + 证明归属”，再只核对财产权例外的两个门槛。

考场速记

记住一句：影响财产权的文书陈述（statement affecting a property interest），先看目的相关，再看后续处分有没有反打脸；没打脸，就能进。

下次看到判决、契据、产权文件，先问它是不是在“说这东西归谁”，别先被民事/刑事标签带跑。
